WashThru RCV-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine: An Advanced Structure and Greater Capacity

Does your station need a touchless automatic car wash machine that can accommodate longer vehicles while featuring an advanced exterior design that gives your site a polished, professional look? The RCV-V1 from WashThru was built exactly for this purpose — manufactured in Saudi Arabia, with a corrosion-resistant aluminum structure and a five-year warranty on the control panel.

For the complete technical details of the RCV-V1 touchless automatic car wash machine, you can download the model's full technical brochure in PDF format here.

What Sets the RCV-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine Apart?

Touchless (brushless) wash technology in the RCV-V1 means every wash cycle relies entirely on high-pressure water and specialized chemicals, with no mechanical contact whatsoever with the vehicle's surface or paint.

What truly sets the RCV-V1 apart, though, is its exterior structure, built from corrosion-resistant aluminum panels with dynamic LED logo lighting, turning it into a visual asset that reinforces your station's image in front of customers.

The RCV-V1 also accommodates vehicles up to 5.9 meters long — a wider range than compact automatic wash models — opening the door to a broader spectrum of large commercial and family vehicles.

Wash Stages in the RCV-V1 Touchless Car Wash Machine

Every vehicle passes through a carefully engineered sequence of stages that ensures the highest level of thorough cleanliness from the very first pass.

Stage One — Pre-Wash Preparation

The exterior is sprayed with low-pressure water combined with specialized chemicals to break down stubborn dirt and residue and prepare the surface before entering the high-pressure stage.

Stage Two — Undercarriage Wash (Optional)

A dedicated stage for cleaning the underside of the chassis and areas standard wash nozzles cannot reach — an addition that reinforces your station's reputation for thoroughness and professionalism.

Stage Three — High-Pressure Wash

24 flat-fan MEG nozzles made of stainless steel spray water simultaneously from the front, rear, top, and sides to remove even the most stubborn dirt.

Stage Four — Foam Application

120 ml of specialized soap is dispensed evenly across the vehicle to deepen the cleaning process and enhance the final shine.

Stage Five — Pre-Rinse

A preliminary rinse removes any remaining foam residue and loosened dirt before moving on to the polishing stage.

Stage Six — Final Rinse with Polish Application

A final rinse stage that includes an optional wax/polish spray from an independent water source to ensure the highest level of shine.

Stage Seven — Full Air Drying (Optional)

The RCV-V1's wash cycle concludes with an advanced drying system that covers every side of the vehicle simultaneously. All of these stages together take just 3 to 4 minutes per vehicle.

Full Technical Specifications of the RCV-V1

The RCV-V1 touchless automatic car wash machine is designed to accommodate the widest possible range of vehicles, including minibuses, large SUVs, and commercial vehicles.

Washable Vehicle Dimensions for the RCV-V1

  • Length: up to 5.9 meters
  • Width: up to 2.3 meters including side mirrors (2.1 meters without)
  • Height: up to 2 meters
  • Machine weight: 1,100 kg

Electrical Power Requirements

The RCV-V1 runs on three-phase power at 380V and 60Hz, with a maximum consumption of 17 kW, while consumption per vehicle does not exceed 0.4 kWh.

Water Consumption Efficiency

  • 220 to 300 liters per vehicle in standard mode
  • Only 25 liters when the built-in water recycling system is activated

Chemical Consumption per Vehicle

  • Soap: 120 ml
  • Pre-wash chemical: 40 to 50 ml
  • Wax/polish: 60 to 80 ml

The RCV-V1's Exterior Structure — A Design That Speaks for Itself

What stands out about the RCV-V1 is that its exterior design is itself part of its marketing value. The exterior shell is built from corrosion-resistant aluminum panels, while all internal contact points are covered in stainless steel housings, and every pipe and fitting is also made of stainless steel to resist moisture and corrosion.

Completing the picture is a dynamic LED logo lighting system that gives your site a distinctive visual presence day and night, while the internal frame is built on hot-dip galvanized steel for maximum rust protection.

Air Drying System in the RCV-V1

The RCV-V1 is equipped with an integrated drying system consisting of 4 top dryers and 2 side dryers, each rated at 5.5 kW, with a combined airflow of up to 17,400 CFM.

This drying power ensures complete, rapid drying from every angle with no need for manual drying, cutting service time and maximizing the number of vehicles processed per hour. Separate air-drying units can be added at the machine's entrance or exit depending on your site's space and layout.

Pressure and Pump System in the RCV-V1

The RCV-V1 relies on a flexible pump system supporting 2 to 3 working pumps depending on site needs, all made of solid stainless steel to ensure the longest operating life in the Gulf's humid environments.

The pumps operate within a safe pressure range of 20 to 24 bar to achieve optimal cleaning results, with the option to upgrade any pump to a high-pressure unit reaching 25 bar, in addition to a medium-pressure pump (9 bar) dedicated to the pre-wash and final rinse, and a separate pump for the undercarriage wash.

Smart Operating Technologies in the RCV-V1 Touchless Car Wash Machine

The RCV-V1 isn't just about washing — it offers a smart management system that gives you full control over your station from anywhere in the world.

Multi-Screen Connectivity

An exclusive RCV-V1 feature that allows up to 6 displays to be connected to the machine simultaneously to broadcast advertising or operational content, opening an additional revenue stream for your station.

10 Customizable Wash Programs, Remotely Adjustable

Lets you offer multiple tiers of wash packages and pricing, with the ability to make instant wireless adjustments without needing to visit the site.

Five-Language Operating Interface

The RCV-V1's interface supports Arabic, English, Hindi, Bengali, and Urdu for smooth operation with any workforce.

Wireless Wi-Fi Control

Access the machine's settings and monitor its performance from any mobile device or tablet, either on-site or remotely through the Wash Cloud platform.

Integration with Electronic Payment Gateways

The RCV-V1 supports full integration with POS devices and smart payment gateways, including mada, Visa, and Mastercard, along with support for an RFID card reader for customer loyalty programs and a license plate recognition camera.

Self-Service Mobile App

The RCV-V1 supports integration with a driver app for full self-service operation without the need for a reception attendant.

Wireless Vehicle Reports

The system keeps a complete historical operating log and lets you review the number of vehicles, their entry times, sizes, and system invoices wirelessly from anywhere.

Safety and Protection Features in the RCV-V1 Touchless Automatic Car Wash Machine

The RCV-V1 touchless car wash machine is built with multi-layered protection that partially or fully shuts down the machine the moment a fault is detected and sends an immediate automatic alert.

  • Digital and analog pressure sensors to protect against dry running
  • Dual protection system for the top dryers combining infrared and ultrasonic sensors
  • Protection against electrical over- and under-current
  • Phase-sequence sensor ensuring continuous safety at every step
  • A VPN-enabled router securing remote access with the highest encryption standards
  • Automatic monthly reports on replaceable parts, with replacement requests sent automatically when needed

The Wash Cloud Platform: Smart Management Without Limits

Wash Cloud is WashThru's proprietary cloud platform built into the RCV-V1, turning the machine from a simple wash unit into a smart, cloud-connected data point around the clock.

The system uses artificial intelligence to read the performance of the RCV-V1's non-consumable parts and estimate their expected lifespan based on precise environmental variables such as temperature, humidity, water salinity, and geographic location. The platform also includes:

  • A smart automated assistant that diagnoses unfamiliar faults and proposes likely causes within seconds
  • Troubleshooting guidance via instructional videos, empowering local technicians to make immediate repairs
  • Automatic reporting of any fault on the RCV-V1 without requiring human intervention
  • Automatic SMS alerts as any part approaches the end of its service life
  • Continuous updates to remote control systems to enhance security and improve performance
  • Full cloud storage of the machine's data and operational reports
  • An API service to connect your ERP systems with the RCV-V1 platform for a nominal fee
